capabilities: Synchronize vault two-way via Yandex Disk
Create ZIP backups on Yandex Disk
Force-replace files from device or cloud
extras: README warns of possible data loss and that the plugin is not a backup; OAuth token and encryption password are stored in plaintext locally; all devices must run the same plugin version, and ZIP creation holds archives in memory.
problem: Keeping an Obsidian vault synchronized across multiple devices requires a cloud storage service and a plugin to manage transfers and conflicts.

relations.evidence: Synchronize your Obsidian vault between computers, phones and tablets through Yandex Disk.

summary: Two-way vault sync plugin that keeps an Obsidian vault in sync across devices via Yandex Disk, with optional encryption and ZIP backups.
